propositions: The DC transport must be built on pycontribs/jira as an opt-in extra with lazy imports to preserve rebar's zero-dependency contract
Auth uses Personal Access Token from JIRA_PAT env var with bearer token, while URL and project come from typed config, failing loudly on ConfigError rather than degrading to env-only
Every method returns raw payload shapes that existing mappers consume, not jira.Issue objects, with retry/timeout/error handling mapped onto rebar's transport contract
TLS verification is never disabled; non-https URLs are rejected unless allow_insecure=true is set; ca_bundle configures internal CAs
Resolved-status classification for the absence probe is configurable via reconciler.resolved_statuses, defaulting to {Resolved, Done, Cancelled} to handle self-hosted workflow naming
Live tests exercise all TicketTransport and support interface methods against the J5 harness, including user-search lookup for NameIdentity resolver and transition-by-name error handling
